R-001.threat: External entity repudiation — external entity denies having sent a request
R-001.cause: No non-repudiation mechanism — requests from external entities are not cryptographically bound to the sender
R-001.attack: External entity denies having sent a command that the system received and acted upon

R-002.threat: Process action repudiation — process denies having performed an action
R-002.cause: Audit log is absent, incomplete, or not tamper-proof
R-002.attack: Process or its operator denies having executed a command that affected the system

R-003.threat: Audit log tampering — attacker modifies or deletes audit log entries
R-003.cause: Audit log lacks integrity protection — entries can be modified after the fact
R-003.attack: Attacker deletes or modifies audit log entries to cover traces of unauthorized actions

R-004.threat: Data store access repudiation — access to the data store cannot be attributed
R-004.cause: No access logging on the data store
R-004.attack: Attacker accesses the data store and denies having done so because no log entry exists

R-005.threat: System action repudiation — system or operator denies having performed a system-level action
R-005.attack: Operator denies having executed a system-level operation that affected other components

R-006.threat: Multiprocess action repudiation — actions inside a multiprocess component cannot be attributed
R-006.cause: No correlated, tamper-proof audit trail across the component's processes — actions cannot be tied to an origin
R-006.attack: Attacker performs actions across the component's processes and denies them, since no consolidated log attributes the activity
